# laravelforge_region (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge provider region by ID. Regions are scoped to a server provider (e.g. DigitalOcean, AWS), not to an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the provider region.
- `provider_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server provider that offers the region (Forge API `provider` path segment; `provider` is reserved in HCL).

### Read-Only

- `alternate_code` (String) Alternate region code, if the provider exposes one.
- `code` (String) Region code used when provisioning (e.g. `ams2`).
- `name` (String) Human-readable region name (e.g. `Amsterdam 2`).
